title: Android RelativeLayout nested wrap-content width
purpose: Check that a nested wrap-content RelativeLayout grows with its child and moves the following sibling.
changes: The nested layout now measures its child positions using the current renderer text metrics and state.
steps: Find Small, More and After under Nested wrap-content relative layout. They should appear next to one another.
Tap Change relative label. Small becomes Longer nested and grows; More and After should both move without overlapping. Tap again to restore Small.
Turn on Right-to-left layout and repeat. The order should mirror with all three controls adjacent. Choose OK if it works, or Reject with the failing step, what you saw and your device.
expected: The nested layout grows and shrinks with its child and both siblings remain adjacent in either direction.
limits: This covers supported Bhoo relative measurement. Opposing parent-edge rules, Android font and theme behavior and device parity remain unverified.
validation: Rust regression verifies nested width, sibling positions, non-default text metrics and RTL.
Full libbhoo Rust test suite passed.
A 320 × 500 browser test verified nested width, sibling placement and RTL.
